description: Sitaara is on a mission to make complex observations of our planet understandable to everyone. We turn hard-to-read scientific data into clear, honest and engaging experiences, labelling what is real and what is illustrative and treating every interpretation as a hypothesis. Our vision is a future where anyone, from a student to a community decision-maker, can explore the rhythms of the Earth through approachable, open tools, with careful storytelling and rigorous science working together.
